_comment: Controlled re-run of reflfix's original design (static, forced-3% core mask, no brightness floor, no region growing -- specular_grow_iters=0 reduces grown_mask exactly to core_mask) but with every unrelated correctness fix from this session applied: FOV-shape-aware boundary exclusion in the core/heuristic computation (no vignette contamination), and FOV-aware neighbor averaging + diffusion_fill in the inpainting kernel (no black-background contamination near the boundary). specular_core_brightness_floor=0.0 disables the floor entirely (every local_max passes trivially), matching original reflfix's pure quantile-only core selection. Paired with v_hk_gpu_full_maskfix_k7_v2 (floor+growth, floor-location bug now fixed) as a controlled A/B isolating just the growth/floor design question.
